sample.natural_source: M6.4 original natural M6 laws, zero initial bonds, 24x24 periodic, enriched density only (264 particles): deliberately selected prior to new sample from M6.12/M6.13 detection enrichment

definitions.valid_native_seven_edge: Exactly eight native particles occupy toroidal 3x3 perimeter, connected by exactly seven ORIGINAL native bonds along 8-cycle positions (linear perimeter path), no off-ring bonds on member components, and degree multiset (1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2). Original M6.12 precursor_candidates.
definitions.native_8_ring_history: At each post-tick observer snapshot, note exact 8-member degree-2 native connected cycles whose coordinates are exact 3x3 perimeter. If material set ever appeared as an exact native 8 ring, first-origin qualification of later 7-edge path with same eight IDs is false.
definitions.first_genesis: The FIRST post-tick snapshot of this set of eight material IDs observed as either an exact seven-edge path OR exact eight-edge ring, across all centers. Qualifying event must be seven-edge native path on that first snapshot; any prior path or ring disqualifies reappearance.
definitions.mobile_resident: Native free central monomer with degree=0 and move_probability>0, resident persistent ID constant from inception.
definitions.continuous_barrier: Same seven original bond identities (no observed or same-tick broken-then-reformed edge), same eight material particles fixed at original perimeter positions, and same center resident ID; independent of eighth edge closing.
definitions.interval: >=30 observed consecutive post-step ticks; episode starting at t and ending on first original break at t+L has length L; t600 right censored. A censored episode with >=30 observed ticks counts as such but marked censored; <30 does not.

primary.success: At least two distinct NEW numeric seeds (13001-14600) have a first_genesis seven-edge original path with mobile resident at first observation, maintaining uninterrupted original seven-edge barrier and resident for >=30 observed ticks; zero-bond initial state.
primary.primary_counts: Distinct numeric seeds, not episodes, not new reclosures, and not prior campaigns.

secondary.report: All worlds/zero runs, first 7 events, previously seen 8 cycles, subsequent reclosures, repeated source material cohorts, censoring and durations, resident IDs, eighth-bond closure timing and event breaks.
secondary.mechanism: Separate observational comparisons first vs recurrent; a longer recurrent cage does NOT prove active self-repair or selection. Record time since last observed original material episode and number of prior episodes; no p-values on dependent episodes.
secondary.frequency: Wilson 95% descriptive interval on 1600 independent numeric-seed worlds for first genesis >=30 and any later repeat >=30; no causal claim.
secondary.historical: No seed or episode from M6.11–M6.13 included in M6.14 primary numerator or denominator.
